_meta.purpose: One recorded run of model_v2 at logistic_ln_ref (brief 078c). A reference for identity test I1; nothing in model_v3 calls v2.
_meta.repo_commit: c78ca1d0af71a5f1ef29aecddf675067ec6037d2 (main at the run; model_v2/ unchanged)
_meta.command: scratch copy of model_v2/ outside the repo, one added line in the copy of WDT_Params.toml ([rates.scenarios.logistic_ln_ref] store_windows = true); then, from model_v2/RATES: python3 rates_core.py --scenario logistic_ln_ref --countries GBR --workers 2 --fresh (check run, writes rates_data.json, no windows without the added line); then python3 extract.py (source below) from the scratch folder, which runs check_inputs, calibrate_levy and sweep for the same cfg in process and writes this file.
last_lines_of_output: levy calibrated to Corporation tax (3.08% of GDP): tau0 3.75% -> 56.34%, tau 70%; median levy 3.08% nominal / 2.63% real (1728 windows)
_meta.headline_found: 7.34 reproduced: it is the MEAN of wdt_gdp_h over the 117 windows (7.3416). The median is 6.594. v3 tests that compare a median against 7.34 compare different statistics.
_meta.not_in_v2: v2 computes no gross post-fill take and no realised eps. Fields kept: the net post-fill take (wdt_gdp_h), whole-window means of tax, refunds and net (tax_gdp_mean, refund_gdp_mean, net_gdp_mean), and er_gain_all / er_stock_all (effective rates on gains and on stock, all adults).
_meta.levy_note: v2 calibrates the entry rate to a levy base of 3.08% of GDP (median, nominal); the post-fill levy it pays, levy_gdp_h, has median 2.774% of GDP, which is the 2.77 in research/model-audit/synthesis.md section 10. No conflict.
_meta.extract_script:
"""Scratch extraction: run v2's logistic_ln_ref (UK) once in-process and write the fixture JSON."""
import sys, json, hashlib, datetime, subprocess, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, 'wealthdeltatax/model_v2'); sys.path.insert(0, 'wealthdeltatax/model_v2/RATES')
import wdt_core as wc, rates_core as rc
p = wc.load_rates_params(None)
name = 'logistic_ln_ref'
sc = p['rates']['scenarios'][name]
cfg = rc.make_cfg(p, **dict(sc['overrides'], countries=['GBR']))
rc.check_inputs(p)
J = rc.load_jst(p['rates']['jst_path'])
cfg['levy'], levy_cal = rc.calibrate_levy(J, cfg, p)
df, cal = rc.sweep(J, cfg, p, pool=None)
df = df[df['mode'] == 'gdp_pc'].reset_index(drop=True)
assert len(df) == 117, len(df)
x = df['wdt_gdp_h'].to_numpy(float)
rp0 = p['rates']; uk0 = rc.panel(J, rp0['uk_iso']); u0 = uk0.loc[rp0['calibration_year']]
adults0 = float(u0['pop']) * 1e3 / cfg['pop_per_adult']
d = rc.build_dist(cfg['dist'], adults0, cfg['dist_mode'], rp0['dist'], **cfg['dist_kw'])
gdp_bn0 = float(u0['gdp'])
cells = [{'label': l, 'adult_share': float(s), 'wealth_bn': float(w), 'mean_gbp_m': float(m)}
         for l, s, w, m in zip(*[d[k] for k in ('labels', 'share', 'wealth_bn', 'mean_gbp_m')])]
rp = p['rates']
uk = rc.panel(J, rp['uk_iso'])
gp = uk['gpc_real'].dropna()
cols = ['fill_year', 'wdt_gdp_h', 'levy_gdp_h', 'relief_gdp', 'fund_inc_gdp_h', 'fund_ret_gdp_h', 'tax_gdp_mean', 'refund_gdp_mean',
        'wdt_gdp_mean', 'net_gdp_mean', 'er_gain_all', 'er_stock_all', 'censored', 'contiguous', 'wraps', 'repeat']
win = [{'start': int(r['start']), **{c: (None if (isinstance(r[c], float) and np.isnan(r[c])) else (bool(r[c]) if c in ('censored', 'contiguous', 'wraps', 'repeat') else float(r[c]))) for c in cols}} for _, r in df.iterrows()]
for w in win: w['fill_year'] = None if w['fill_year'] is None else int(w['fill_year'])
tom = open('wealthdeltatax/model_v2/WDT_Params.toml', 'rb').read()
out = {'headline': {}, 'windows': win}
out['headline'] = {
    'scenario': name, 'index_mode': 'gdp_pc', 'country': 'GBR', 'n_windows': len(win),
    'statistic': 'mean over the 117 UK loop windows of wdt_gdp_h',
    'wdt_gdp_h_mean_pct_of_gdp': float(100 * x.mean()),
    'wdt_gdp_h_median_pct_of_gdp': float(100 * np.median(x)),
    'definition': ('wdt_gdp_h = rates_core._horizon_cols: sum over the post-fill years fill..fill+horizon-1 (horizon 10) of net individual WDT '
                   '(out["net"], net of refunds, tax + death tax + heirs - refunds, no corporate levy) x scale, over the sum of scale (GDP), '
                   'a ratio of sums, per window. The recorded 7.34 is the MEAN of this column over the 117 windows (research/model-audit/synthesis.md section 10); '
                   'the median, which rates_core.headline prints, is the second number.'),
    'levy_gdp_h_mean_pct': float(100 * df['levy_gdp_h'].mean()), 'relief_gdp_mean_pct': float(100 * df['relief_gdp'].mean()),
}
out['units'] = 'per-window numbers are fractions of GDP as v2 writes them (0.0734 is 7.34%); headline numbers are in percent'
out['calibration'] = {'cells': cells, 'n_cells': len(cells), 'total_bn': float(d['total_bn']), 'n_adults': float(d['n_adults']),
    'gdp_bn': gdp_bn0, 'wealth_to_gdp': float(cal['wealth_to_gdp']),
    'wmin_gbp_m': float(cal['wmin_gbp_m']), 'house_median_gbp_m': float(rp['dist']['house_median_gbp_m']),
    'wmin_house_ratio': cfg['wmin_house_ratio'], 'dist': cfg['dist'], 'dist_mode': cfg['dist_mode'], 'dist_kw': cfg['dist_kw'],
    'repaired_cells': int(d['repaired_cells']), 'calibration_year': rp['calibration_year']}
out['gpc_real'] = {'years': [int(i) for i in gp.index], 'values': [float(v) for v in gp.values],
                   'note': "uk['gpc_real'] = (1+gpc)/(1+infl)-1, nominal GDP per head growth deflated by CPI; the threshold index in index mode gdp_pc"}
out['settings'] = {'cfg': json.loads(json.dumps(cfg, default=float)), 'levy_cal': json.loads(json.dumps(levy_cal, default=float)),
                   'toml_sha256': hashlib.sha256(tom).hexdigest(), 'params_hash': wc.params_hash(p) if hasattr(wc, 'params_hash') else None,
                   'scratch_toml_change': 'store_windows = true added to [rates.scenarios.logistic_ln_ref]; no effect on numbers'}
json.dump(out, open('out_raw.json', 'w'), indent=1)
print('mean', 100 * x.mean(), 'median', 100 * np.median(x), 'cells', len(cells), 'total', d['total_bn'], 'gdp', out['calibration']['gdp_bn'])
